crossRefs.note: Now Solomon decided to build a house for Yahweh’s name, and a house for his kingdom.
When Solomon had finished the building of Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was…
I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.
Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced…
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Thus Solomon finished Yahweh’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in Yahweh’s house and in his own house.
translations.bsb: When Solomon had finished the house of the LORD and the royal palace, successfully carrying out all that was in his heart to do for the house of the LORD and for his own palace,
translations.kjv: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
translations.asv: Thus Solomon finished the house of Jehovah, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of Jehovah, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
